scenarios.answer:
Our return policy allows you to return products that are undamaged and complete. You can try the product, but items with signs of use are not accepted. You only need your order number to initiate a return; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date; after 30 days, returns are not accepted and the product will be handled under warranty. 

If you use our contracted carrier, Anadolu Kargo, for the return, the shipping cost is free by showing the return code at the branch. If you use your own courier, the shipping fee will not be refunded. Once the product reaches our warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, refunds are made to the account holder's IBAN.

Please note that opened in-ear headphones, personal care products, opened software packages, and custom-made products cannot be returned.

To start a return, go to your account's Orders section, select the product, and create a return request by choosing a reason. After approval, you will receive an 8-digit return code via email, valid for 7 days. You must send the product back within this period using the original packaging and the return code at Anadolu Kargo. The warehouse will inspect the product within 2 business days and notify you of the result.

If you haven't shipped the product yet, you can cancel the return request from your Orders page; once shipped, cancellation is not possible.

This policy ensures a smooth and clear return process for our customers.
